# Repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CONTEXT.md` and the relevant scoped rules before working.
Use `docs/audit-findings.md` as the only repository backlog, including deferred work and
skill/deployment follow-ups. Follow CLAUDE.md's shared-backlog policy; do not create a Copilot-only
queue or leave unresolved work solely in chat. If the operating manual or ledger cannot be
read, report that limitation instead of inventing a substitute tracker.
